content.title: Festal Letter 39
content.author: Athanasius of Alexandria · New Advent edition
content.note: A historical witness to the books Athanasius received, including the 27 books of the New Testament. One bishop's list is evidence within a wider history of reception. Used for the New Testament list in section 5, not as our standard for the Old Testament canon.
